name: Roasted Pumpkin Chickpea Bowl
ingredients: ½ cup cooked millet or quinoa
1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp chilli powder
Dressing: juice of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp plain soy yogurt, salt
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the pumpkin, chickpeas and tofu with the oil and spices.
Wilt the kale briefly in a hot pan or leave raw.
Divide the grain and kale between bowls and top with the roast mixture.
note: Pumpkin is lower in carbohydrate than sweet potato; the legumes and tofu keep protein high.
